candidates.name: mlex (mlx-c)

evidence.claim: statically links mlx/mlx-c; macOS Apple Silicon; CI on macos-latest

candidates.decision_rationale: Used by KnowMe; official mlx-c underneath.

candidates.name: llama-cpp-2
risks: architecture rule forbids it on iOS/Android
candidates.decision_rationale: OPERATOR-GATED (decision 10): adopt only if Windows/Linux is in scope; the proposed default (macOS only) leaves it out.

candidates.name: mlx-swift + mlx-swift-lm

evidence.claim: iOS simulator not supported for MLX inference; use Mac (Designed for iPad)

risks: Swift bridge must be in project.pbxproj

candidates.name: LiteRT-LM Android AAR

evidence.claim: maintainer: non-CPU backends not recommended on emulators

risks: JNI path must be a legal Java identifier
candidates.decision_rationale: KnowMe pins 0.14.0; upgrade and verify CPU on arm64 emulator in first spike.

candidates.name: candle (CPU fallback lane)

evidence.claim: Android emulator via frb failed; issue closed, Android support not confirmed

risks: adds an engine for chat, but UAR main already pulls candle 0.9.2 through surreal-memory local-embeddings (Cargo.toml:455-461), so the build cost is partly paid when UAR is embedded
candidates.decision_rationale: Only if the operator wants simulator chat evidence.

evidence.claim: invalid-weight errors on Qwen 2.5 GGUF on iOS

candidates.name: Qwen3-0.6B (MLX/LiteRT-LM/GGUF)
candidates.decision_rationale: OPERATOR-GATED (decision 5). Smallest Apache-2.0, ungated family in all three formats with tool calling stated (SmolLM2 tool use unverified; Gemma 4 E2B too large). Fitness for structured setup proposals is unmeasured; Spec includes a feasibility spike.

candidates.name: Gemma 3 1B / 270M

evidence.claim: prohibits automated decisions in healthcare/insurance and unlicensed medical practice

candidates.decision_rationale: Licence clauses and gating unsuitable for a prior-auth practice product.

evidence.claim: commercial use capped at USD 10M annual revenue

candidates.name: Gemma 4 E2B
candidates.decision_rationale: Reference-app model; too large for onboarding.

candidates.name: fastembed + ort

evidence.claim: prebuilt ONNX Runtime for aarch64-apple-ios, -ios-sim, aarch64/x86_64-linux-android

risks: disable default features but re-enable ort-download-binaries-rustls-tls (as KnowMe Cargo.toml:122); no hf-hub at runtime
supply chain: ort downloads prebuilt ONNX Runtime from cdn.pyke.io at build time (hash-pinned in dist.tsv); record as a build-time network fetch
two embedders if UAR is embedded: surreal-memory local-embeddings uses candle 0.9.2
candidates.decision_rationale: Two majors ahead of KnowMe; covers simulator and emulator.

candidates.name: snowflake-arctic-embed-xs
candidates.decision_rationale: Same dims/size as MiniLM, better retrieval, fastembed-supported.

candidates.name: SurrealDB embedded (RocksDB) on mobile
risks: sub-crates float unless Cargo.lock is held
candidates.decision_rationale: OPERATOR-GATED (decision 7; departs from the doctrine, needs an ADR). One store engine on desktop and mobile; alternative sqlite-vec 0.1.9.

candidates.name: UAR EmbeddedRuntime + ExternalLlmDriver
candidates.fit_for_gap: UAR on iOS/desktop host with host-supplied driver

maintenance.version: tag v1.3.0 (2026-10-24, commit 77446974); origin/main 7ee9bf31 is ahead; CHANGELOG still reads 1.3.0 unreleased (verification pending); local checkout is 1.1.1

evidence.claim: in-process AG-UI encoder for embedded hosts

risks: risk acceptance needed: embedding API is not a stability contract, mobile embedding is Experimental, nightly pin
candidates.decision_rationale: OPERATOR-GATED (decisions 12 and 14). Required by goal 4; gate behind a build spike. Embedded UAR also refuses to build without a host persistence layer, an explicit governance engine and an explicit tool admission port (src/embedded.rs:493-595); B5 must supply all four.

candidates.name: UAR uar-sidecar

evidence.claim: stdin token, READY:{port}, exit on EOF

candidates.decision_rationale: OPERATOR-GATED (decision 3). Topology option (b) and the desktop fallback if the embedding spike fails: build isolation from UAR, at the cost of no host-supplied driver in UAR and no iOS use.

candidates.name: Rust AG-UI crates (ag-ui-core, ag-ui, ag-ui-protocol)
candidates.decision_rationale: UAR builds payloads by hand; PatientGPT already has its own subset types.

build_required.need: patient-gpt-inference crate: InferenceProvider, Lane enum, catalog, downloader, RAM preflight, progress (adapted from KnowMe)
build_required.why_no_candidate: No published crate provides per-device engine selection with pinned acquisition; KnowMe code is a reference, not a library.

build_required.need: Swift MLX bridge and Kotlin LiteRT-LM JNI bridge
build_required.why_no_candidate: Engines are native-SDK only; bridges are app-specific.

build_required.need: Host port and transport mirror for lane, model status, prepare, embed (HTTP/Tauri/FFI)
UarRuntimeFacade over EmbeddedRuntime with AG-UI message framing
build_required.why_no_candidate: UAR exposes primitives only; framing lives in its server loop.

build_required.need: UAR HTTP service client for the cloud host (goal 4) plus the shared AG-UI routing layer used by the cloud host, the desktop host crate and the iOS embedding
build_required.why_no_candidate: UAR publishes no Rust client crate; the routing split (UAR vs host-local handlers) is PatientGPT-specific.

build_required.need: Host setup commands for onboarding (the write path the model's proposals use), mirrored across HTTP, Tauri and FFI, executed only by the trusted host after user confirmation
build_required.why_no_candidate: The frozen transport mirror has six read/run operations and no setup writes; what the decentralized deployment configures is product-specific (decision 15).

build_required.need: UAR host components: PersistenceLayer, GovernanceEngine, HostToolAdmissionPort (enforcing agent-cannot-affirm/sign/submit) and driver selection that keeps clinical runs off the local model
build_required.why_no_candidate: EmbeddedRuntime requires host-supplied implementations; policy is PatientGPT's.

build_required.need: Model-driven onboarding with host-executed, user-confirmed setup actions
build_required.why_no_candidate: Product-specific; capability inversion requires host execution.
